content: Wɔ̃ɔ yɛndun bɑɑ sɔɔrɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru kɑ sere mɑɑ win tiin sinɑ kpɑɑru bɑnɑ u kpɑ.
U mɑɑ wuu si Hurɑmu u nùn kɑ̃ sɔnwɑ. Mɑ u derɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ sinɑ mi.
Sɑlomɔɔ u Hɑmɑti wɔri ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Sobɑn berɑ ɡiɑ, mɑ u ye mwɑ.
U tem mi ɡɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ kpin wuu ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Tɑdimɔri bɑnɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ Hɑmɑtin wuu sìn mi bɑ ko n dɑ win dĩɑnu bere.
U Bɛti Horoni ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡunɡuru wɔllɔ kɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɔwɑɔ bɑnɑ. Wuu si, su ɡbɑ̃rɑnu kɑ ɡɑmbobɑ mɔ, kɑ mɑɑ yen sɛ̃retinu.

U mɑɑ wuu ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Bɑlɑti bɑnɑ kɑ wuu sìn mi u ko n dɑ win dĩɑnu bere. Mɑ u sin ɡɑsu sɔɔ win tɑbu kɛkɛ yi dumi ɡɑwe beruɑ kɑ mɑɑsɔbu. Ye Sɑlomɔɔn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ kĩ, yerɑ u bɑnɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ kɑ Libɑniɔ, kɑ sere wuu si u mɔ sɔɔ.
Tɔn be bɑ tie Hɛtibɑ sɔɔ, kɑ Amɔrebɑ sɔɔ, kɑ Feresibɑ sɔɔ, kɑ Hefibɑ sɔɔ, kɑ Yebusibɑ sɔɔ, be, be bɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑ,
ben bibun bwese te tɑ seewɑ ben biru, terɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u yoo sɔmɑ koosiɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔn ɡisɔ.
Sɑlomɔɔ u ǹ Isirelibɑn ɡoo yoo sɔmburu koosie. Be, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ win tɑbu kowobu kɑ wiruɡibu, kɑ tɑbu sinɑmbu, kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ yi dumi ɡɑwen kpɑrobu.
Wiruɡii be Sɑlomɔɔ u ɡɔsɑ bu kɑ win tɔmbu kpɑrɑ sɔmbu te sɔɔ, ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡoobu kɑ weerɑɑkuru (250).

Sɑlomɔɔ u derɑ win kurɔ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Eɡibiti sunɔn bii u yɑrɑ Dɑfidin yɛnun di ɡe u bɑnɑ. U nɛɛ, win kurɔ kun sinɑmɔ Dɑfidi Isirelibɑn sinɑ bokon yɛnuɔ. Domi mi bɑ woodɑn kpɑkororu doke, yɑm mi, mu kuɑwɑ mi yɑm dɛɛrɑm.
Yerɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kuɑ yɑ̃ku yee ten wɔllɔ te u bɑnɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun wuswɑɑɔ.

U rɑ yɑ̃kunu ko nɡe mɛ Mɔwisin woodɑ yɑ ɡeruɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑteren sɔ̃, kɑ suru kpɑon sɔ̃, kɑ tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃ɛrɑruɡiru sɔɔ kɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑnu itɑ yenin sɔ̃ ni bɑ rɑ ko wɔ̃ɔ tiɑ sɔɔ. Niyɑ pɛ̃ɛ ye bɑ ku rɑ seeyɑtiɑ doken tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru, kɑ duurubun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru, kɑ sere mɑɑ Kunun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru.

U yɑ̃ku kowobu yi wuu wuukɑ nɡe mɛ win tundo Dɑfidi u rɑɑ kuɑ. Yɑ̃ku kowo ben bɑɑwure kɑ win sɔmburu. Lefibɑ kɑ mɑɑ ben sɔmburu. Berɑ bɑ rɑ n Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑmɔ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere kpɑ bu mɑɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu somi ben sɔmɑ sɔɔ. Mɑ bɑ kɔnnɔsun kɔ̃sobu yi yi wuu wuukɑ.
Bɑ ǹ sinɑ bokon woodɑ sɑre ye u yi yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑn sɔ̃ kɑ sere mɑɑ ɑrumɑni beru yerun sɔ̃.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔmbu te kpuro kpɑrɑ sɑɑ ten torubun di sere bɑ dɑ bɑ kɑ tu wiru ɡo. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ kɑ dii te bɑnɑ bɑ kpɑ.
Yen biru Sɑlomɔɔ u dɑ Ɛsioni Gebɛɛɔ kɑ Elɔtuɔ. Wuu si, su wɑ̃ɑwɑ nim wɔ̃kun bɔkuɔ Edɔmun temɔ.
Hurɑmu u derɑ win sɔm kowo be bɑ nim yɛ̃ bɑ kɑ Sɑlomɔɔ ɡoo nimkusu dɑɑwɑ. Mɑ bɑ dɑ Ofiriɔ kɑ Sɑlomɔɔn sɔm kowobu sɑnnu. Min diyɑ bɑ kɑ sinɑ boko Sɑlomɔɔ wurɑn tɔnnu wɔkurɑ itɑ nɑɑwɑ.
